title: Local finiteness of SIRSN traffic intensity
exact_target: Find sufficient regularity for finite traffic through bounded portions of major roads when trips have power-law displacement density with exponent between two and four.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9700031 (AMR-096-0031). CC BY 4.0.
David J. Aldous, \emph{Scale-Invariant Random Spatial Networks}, arXiv:1204.0817v1 (2012), Section 8.3, Open Problem 31, pp. 48--49.
